$Comment: Sawyer Marn, the character who hands out the Sawmill quests and takes their deliveries. A thin variant: Template_Mmo_QuestGiver (shipped in the MMO Skill Tree jar) holds the entire body - the idle / watch / interact behaviour and the press-F action - and this file only says what makes Marn look and read as Marn. Point a placement's Identity.Role at "Mmo_Sawyer" to stand him somewhere; this pack does so in NpcPlacements/Mmo_Sawyer_Temple.json. Modify may name ONLY the parameters that template declares: Appearance, NameTranslationKey, Weapons, OffHand, DefaultOffHandSlot. Naming anything else makes the engine refuse the whole role, which shows up in game as a character who never appears. Appearance is a Model asset id, so any vanilla model works here - swap it and Marn looks like someone else with no other change. Weapons is what he holds, first entry in hand; an iron hatchet reads as a sawyer at a glance. NameTranslationKey is his nameplate, shipped in this pack's npcs.lang. The press-F prompt is baked into the template and shared with every giver using it; to give one its own prompt, copy that template, edit the copy's Hint, and Reference the copy instead.
